commit_message: Align Timeline schema with ADR0126 first release
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion on current main. This batch narrows Timeline authoring to the six required initial track families, replaces raw animation asset ownership with stable Animation Set motion-slot references, adds an explicit Transform property registry, permits targetless non-spatial Audio tracks while restricting spatial bindings to stable entities, and bounds Timeline Event names/payloads.

Draft PR remains intentionally unmerged while runtime composition, Project Rust, Sequencer preview, packaged-player parity, and Visual Validation are completed.
